docket_entries.description: NOTICE OF APPEAL OF THE ORDER, DECISION OR AWARD OF THE LABOR COMMISSIONER FILED BY PLAINTIFF BRARDA, ROGER H AS TO DEFENDANT DANIEL CREAMERY, INC
NOTICE OF TIME AND PLACE MAILED (LABOR APPEAL) COURT TRIAL SET FOR FEB-08-1994 AT 09:00 AM IN DEPT 03

THE FOLLOWING JUDGMENT WAS REACHED BY STIPULATION. DEFENDANT, DANIEL CREAMERY INC, IS TO PAY PLAINTIFF, ROGER BRARDA $4,500 IN 20 DAYS--BY 2-28-94. THIS MONEY IS TO BE PAID BY CASHIER'S CHECK, MONEY ORDER OR CASH. THE TRIAL, IN THIS MATTER, IS TO CONTINUE FOR 30 DAYS UNTIL 3-8-94.
